title: Where She Went
author: Gayle Forman
summary: Three years after the accident in If I Stay, Adam is a rock star and Mia a rising cellist. A chance meeting in New York gives them one night to talk about what went wrong between them.
readIf: you read If I Stay and want to know where Adam and Mia ended up.
skipIf: you have not read the first book or dislike music-heavy, emotional YA.
